First release of **certfan**: probe every IP behind a TLS hostname and catch the node still serving an old, expiring or broken certificate.

- `certfan check host[:port] ...`: resolves all A/AAAA, TLS+SNI per address, flags certificate mismatch, verification errors, expiry and low remaining-lifetime %
- `--connect IP[:PORT]` to probe explicit backends, `-4/-6`, `--cafile`, `--no-verify`
- `--format text|json|prom`, `--prom-file` for node_exporter, exit codes 0/1/2
- `certfan demo`: offline, three local nodes, one with a different cert
- Zero dependencies, Python 3.9+

Install: `pipx install "git+https://github.com/Blackman99/certfan@v0.1.0"` or the wheel below.
